scope: Container ownership audit only; not a general CSS audit.

findings.container_problem: One disclosure contains multiple independent workspace-management tasks and its selected-Version inspector/comparison.
findings.recommendation: Move it to a dedicated Plan > Scenarios tool. Keep common plan controls as the only primary Setup content.
findings.why_it_misrepresents_boundary: Scenario/Version management is not a Setup input; the disclosure is long enough to become a second tool.

findings.container_problem: Validation, Material, and Reflection are all stacked inside one lazy Research disclosure.
findings.recommendation: One small internal subview selector; mount only the chosen workflow. Keep the outer Research boundary and canonical actions.
findings.why_it_misrepresents_boundary: Three independent evidence workflows each own inputs, actions, output, and status, making a single accordion a long mixed-responsibility form.

findings.container_problem: Filters/list and complete Run details/solutions use one drawer, while CSS attempts nested master/detail columns in only 320–360px.
findings.recommendation: Single-column master/detail within the History tool: list/filter state, then selected Run detail with Back. Put full lineage under details; solution selection remains inside the Run detail.
findings.why_it_misrepresents_boundary: History browsing, selected record inspection, provenance, and Apply/Report workflows receive equal vertical/column weight.

findings.container_problem: Score, individual metric cards, feasibility, cell configuration, explanation, and provenance compete as peer blocks.
findings.recommendation: Score + feasibility + primary objectives first; compact metric rows next; configuration and explanation progressively disclosed; provenance tertiary.
findings.why_it_misrepresents_boundary: A summary metric and raw evidence/provenance answer different user questions.

findings.container_problem: Quality, counts, dataset/model/application versions are rendered as similar mini-datum tiles.
findings.recommendation: Compact the planning summary and split Dataset QA/Provenance details from a clearly named Measurements & calibration workflow. Keep field calibration separate from RF Diagnostics campaign validation: the former can explicitly apply a plan correction; the latter is an evidence ledger that never promotes a model.
findings.why_it_misrepresents_boundary: Planning confidence and implementation metadata are not peer-level facts.

findings.container_problem: Each objective is a large card with label, direction, slider and full description.
findings.recommendation: One objective per compact row with visible label/direction/value/slider; keep a short meaning always visible and long help in info/disclosure.
findings.why_it_misrepresents_boundary: Repeated card framing makes five equivalent weights look like five separate tasks and inflates drawer height.

findings.container_problem: Sparse initial tool is nested inside an Advanced disclosure and can grow into summary/detail/diagnostics cards.
findings.recommendation: Keep the top-level tool and show scope, one Run action, then one result/empty state; no placeholders or cards for absent values.
findings.why_it_misrepresents_boundary: One explicit action does not need empty boxes; output/limits are one workflow.

findings.container_problem: Status, developer command, path summary, functions, scenarios, sessions and event timeline form a large stack when enabled.
findings.recommendation: Keep a compact status/toggle and path summary primary; tuck developer command and verbose events under explicit details.
findings.why_it_misrepresents_boundary: Optional connection setup and live network evidence have different audiences/frequency.

findings.container_problem: Interference sample renders about twenty mini-datum facts and explanation with equal weight.
findings.recommendation: Inspector key facts first; model/power decomposition and source details under Details/Provenance.
findings.why_it_misrepresents_boundary: Primary radio-quality outcome, supporting power terms, and evidence fields are currently peer facts.

findings.container_problem: A result source/context disclosure precedes Results subviews.
findings.recommendation: Retain compact source/freshness placement; do not promote hashes or full lineage to peer cards.
findings.why_it_misrepresents_boundary: This is a useful distinct lineage container.

visual_principles: Prefer compact key/value rows to one-card-per-fact layouts.
Use containers only where ownership changes: task, entity, result, or evidence.
Avoid nested cards; a small section header/divider is enough for one subtask.
Do not visually imply equal confidence or priority for data quality, summary metrics, and hashes.
